changes: Portable exact tool-status DTO; explicit trusted host identity check shared by HTTP, CLI and three-language UI.
GET never identifies or executes a tool; cached status is invalidated by candidate metadata changes, never authorizes execution.
Source catalog failures no longer block owned frozen runtime/inspection/tool status; fresh author input remains mandatory for new plan/build.

application.cause: Three trusted adapter fixtures still supplied a fictional executable path. They now use a real stat-only candidate path; execution remains injected.

prepared.cause: An expired source catalog could abort frozen runtime status after the author directory was moved offline. Fixed with bounded cached discovery and mandatory fresh author admission for new plan/build.

browser.cause: Acceptance script clicked during startup before host capability detection and edit mode. Waits now require the visible enabled entry; no tool-check product failure was found.

recordingCorrection.cause: Initial terminal-state wait could collect the preceding plan twice and omit the build record. The acceptance script now requires a fresh task UUID and the expected kind. All four scenarios and three locales were rerun; the final three records are distinct plan/build/run successes.

native.note: The existing Bevy native 0.3.0 tool was identified and used, not rebuilt. Rust editor and Bevy sources and frozen WASM bytes remain unchanged; prior standalone Rust reports keep their original conditions.

limits: Linux local editor service and source CLI only. No installed Tauri window or Android device acceptance.
No new application version, commit/push, installer, installation, GitHub Release or tag.
No engine discovery/configuration UI or automatic downloads; host still selects a fixed trusted backend and tool.
Godot adapter 0.5.0, Bevy adapter/native 0.3.0, author formats and existing plan/runtime protocols unchanged.
No GPU/embedded viewport/reflection/live RPC or authored Rust behavior added.
